Container.Name: Audiotheca
Container.Overview: Audiotheca v1.0.12 (engine 10.0.0) scans, deduplicates, and restructures large audio sample libraries on local disk. Includes browser UI and API in one container.[br][br][b]Before adding:[/b] build the image once on Unraid: [code]bash /path/to/audiotheca/deploy/unraid/build-image.sh[/code][br]Or install the template: [code]bash deploy/unraid/install-template.sh[/code]
Container.Requires: Self-built image [b]audiotheca/unraid:latest[/b] — run deploy/unraid/build-image.sh on Unraid first.
Container.Description: Audiotheca library scan and organization for Unraid.[br][br] [b]Web UI[/b] — port 4210 (nginx, proxies /api internally)[br] [b]API[/b] — leave unpublished; UI nginx proxies /api (set strong tokens below)[br][br] [b]Appdata[/b] (/data) — reports, scan cache, API token, feedback JSON[br] [b]Library[/b] (/library) — local array path to _software/_audio (read-only recommended)[br][br] [b]Setup[/b][br] 1. Copy repo to Unraid (or git clone)[br] 2. [code]bash deploy/unraid/build-image.sh[/code][br] 3. [code]bash deploy/unraid/install-template.sh[/code][br] 4. Docker → Add Container → Template: Audiotheca → set API token + proxy secret → Apply[br]

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Reports, scan cache, API token, feedback (AUDIOTHECA_HOME)

Config.Name: Library
Config.Description: Local audio library on array — not an SMB path from another PC

Config.Name: AUDIOTHECA_LIBRARY_ROOT
Config.Description: Container library root (match Library path mount)

Config.Name: AUDIOTHECA_API_TOKEN
Config.Description: Required fixed API token (long random string)

Config.Name: AUDIOTHECA_PROXY_SECRET
Config.Description: Shared secret for nginx→API session minting (required; different from API token)

Config.Name: AUDIOTHECA_DISABLE_TOKEN_BOOTSTRAP
Config.Description: Keep 1 for LAN — sessions via proxy secret only
